description_en: Deletes the specified SQL firewall rules
kebab_example: aliyun polardb delete-firewall-rules --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --rule-name-list testrule --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteFirewallRules

parameters.help_en:
The names of the firewall rules to delete. You can specify multiple rule names. Separate the names with commas (,).

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html operation to query the details of all firewall rules for the cluster, including the rule names
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的防火墙规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量删除，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html接口查看目标集群下所有防火墙规则的详情，包括规则名称
parameters.name: rule_name_list

Message.description_en:

If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message is returned
